component.name: PatraPDF
component.summary: Fill in, sign, redact and watermark PDFs

description.p: PatraPDF fills in and signs PDF forms entirely on your computer. Nothing is uploaded.

ul.li: Type text, add dates and checkmarks anywhere on a page
Place your signature from an image; the paper background is removed automatically
Highlight text, draw freehand, and add shapes and arrows
Redact: black out content and remove it from the file for good
Find text in the document, and select text to copy it
Work on several documents in windows of their own
Stamp a watermark across every page
Delete and reorder pages, and add pages from other PDFs

description.p: Scroll bars, and the page thumbnails follow the document as it is scrolled.
Select text: drag over the document's text, or double-click a word, and copy it.
Annotate: highlight text, draw freehand, and add rectangles, ovals, lines and arrows.
Find text in the document, and open each document in a window of its own.
Copy the finished PDF to the clipboard, to paste straight into an email, a chat or a folder.
Redacting or deleting a page now also removes every copy of its form values from the file.
Add pages from another PDF: choose the file, then which of its pages.
A Help menu lists every keyboard shortcut, and both sidebars can be hidden.
Long documents scroll and zoom smoothly: only the pages on screen are drawn.
Documents open in the background, and pages render and save faster.
Pasting works in form fields and the Recents search; form field borders keep their width.
Fill in a PDF's own form fields; the saved copy stays fillable.
Open password-protected PDFs, and save copies with a new password, the same one, or none.
Text in non-Latin scripts, written with fonts from your computer.
White redaction boxes, and a searchable Recents gallery.
Automatic updates: new versions are downloaded in the background, verified against the project's signing key, and installed on restart.
